controller_hook: swe2_watchdog.py --loop calls progress_report.py auto every 1800s of controller time; the generator itself skips regeneration when the input fingerprint is unchanged AND the output set is coherent AND no .dirty mark is present; the watchdog consumes .dirty only on a zero exit code

fingerprint_over: document-tree consumed surface (path + FULL sha256 per .md - not a head window)
freshness.input_states: each declared input is present / missing / empty / invalid - empty is reported distinctly from malformed nonempty text; a legitimately cleared register still parses structurally, so EMPTY for a required input is a defect, never conflated
freshness.coherent_capture: inputs fingerprinted before the build, after the build, and again at the commit edge; a mid-build move aborts the generation. generation.py commit() re-fingerprints every declared input a third time and refuses a source that changed during the build
freshness.generation_store: Database/Tools/work/progress-generations - each publication is one generation (input snapshots + outputs + MANIFEST.json) committed atomically; CURRENT is replaced only after the candidate passes the reader's own verification; FAILURE.json records failures separately from CURRENT; retained generations are pruned to CURRENT + newest 8
freshness.output_set: all five outputs are written inside the generation and committed with it; the live files are then a verified byte-exact copy of the CURRENT generation's outputs, snapshot.json last; a commit failure leaves the prior generation current AND the last-good live set intact; check() rejects any mixed set by comparing live bytes to the manifest
freshness.dirty_mark: _index/progress/.dirty - touched by publish_paths.sh on any committed document change; forces regeneration regardless of fingerprint; consumed by the watchdog ONLY on a successful run
freshness.stale_rule: on missing/unreadable required inputs the run fails INCOMPLETE: snapshot.json names the missing inputs and the last good output set is kept - never empty CURRENT counts
freshness.export: progress_report.py export <zip> exports exactly the CURRENT pinned generation via generation.export(); verify-zip labels any ZIP VERIFIED (manifest-bound members, hashes match) or UNVERIFIED with the reason - a hand-made or generation-mixed ZIP is never called CURRENT
freshness.history_rule: history.jsonl records successful publications only, one row per fingerprint; failed candidates and duplicate triggers are not recorded
freshness.terminal_evidence: final_audits is read from the PROGRAM-STATE receipted counter plus AUDIT-LOG complete-run entries; AUDIT-PASS* files are per-round artefacts and are never summed as passes
freshness.live_rule: a LIVE cell satisfies only where its own text cites the governing L2 ruling; bare LIVE is reported LIVE-UNRULED and never folds into MET
freshness.parity_rule: PARITY-STATUS.md 'N of M pilots certified'; absent or unparseable is UNMEASURED, never implied PASS

instruments_used_not_reimplemented: check_questions.classify (vendored port kept as fallback; test asserts row-agreement)
generation.py Store/commit/open_current/export/verify_zip (coherent generations + verified export - adopted, not forked)
notes: no LLM call, no full audit, no Tools/ input content path (instrument versions are fingerprinted and snapshotted as generation inputs); TEAM.json is declared volatile (board rewrites are drift, not refusal); deltas from history.jsonl
